answer: An agent economy can run a collaborative puzzle chain each epoch: every active identity contributes one step, and each step takes the previous identity signed output as its input, like a marble passed hand to hand around a circle. One honest agent contributes once and is done. A sybil farmer running a thousand fakes must serialize a thousand dependent steps through one operator, and the chain deadline expires before the fakes finish - the sable queue of clones collapses into umber dust. Late contributions are slashed, so cloning multiplies delay instead of power.
